scope: Inspect both original recordings, identify every distinguishable tree design/appearance variant supported by their pixels, and create a separate eight-view turnaround for each confirmed distinct design. Do not infer source-model count from Havenline's existing three pine models.

output_contract.angle_convention: 0 degrees is a chosen reference-facing convention, not a known original model axis.
output_contract.camera: Fixed elevated near-orthographic source-like camera within each sheet.

acceptance_checks: Original source bytes verified against authoritative reference lock.
Both videos audited for distinguishable tree designs; scale, rotation, occlusion and camera pitch are not automatically counted as new designs.
Direct source crops for every depicted design, with timestamps, crop coordinates and hashes.
Observed silhouette, tier count/proportions, skirt notch character, source colors, tiny trunk and smooth rendering style matched.
Eight clearly labeled full views per design, preserving consistent geometry/material/scale and grounded contact shadows.
Separate critic inspects actual full sheets, all view crops, source comparisons and relevant closeups; known defects repaired and retested.
Every generated revision and its status preserved in GitHub; no old source/model approval silently reused.
A literal 100-percent match is not certified for unobserved geometry or visibly imperfect reconstruction.
evidence_boundary: The inspected B footage does not expose a full orbit of one identified tree. Hidden sides are reconstructed unless additional original evidence establishes them; this constraint does not waive the user's requested match target.

milestones.name: Audit all tree designs in both recordings
Generate eight views for each supported design
Preserve reviewed outputs and evidence in GitHub
